main.description: An owner puts a canvas in a context, or a folder in one: a board of cells a room paints together, one placement per person per cooldown. It has a place in the tree like any node, and starts open.

path.description: Where it is, so a screen that has just made it can go straight there.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such context, or none the caller may read.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller does not own the context.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: No such parent, a parent that is neither a context nor a folder, or no name.
